Hashtag Research

Tags worth your post.

Type your topic and get hashtag suggestions with the numbers that matter: how many posts and comments each tag pulls a day, its total volume, and how hard it is to be seen in it. Big is not always better — low-competition tags are where a small account actually gets found.

DEMO — SAMPLE NUMBERS SHOWN FOR THE LAYOUT · LIVE VOLUME ARRIVES WITH THE X SEARCH CONNECTION

01 · The topic

A topic, a niche, or the announcement itself. Suggestions are built from your words plus your category's working tags.

Type a topic — two or three words is enough.

What matters most?

Reach favours volume, “Easy to rank” favours low competition, Conversation favours comment-heavy tags. The verdict on each tag follows your pick.

2–3 TAGS PER POST BEATS 10 — XRAYKIT MARKS THE SET WORTH USING.

What the research shows you

Every suggested tag comes with the four numbers a founder actually decides on:

  • Daily posts — how much new content fights for the tag each day
  • Daily comments — how much conversation the tag pulls (replies are where small accounts get seen)
  • Total volume — the tag's overall footprint on X
  • Competition — High / Medium / Low: how hard it is for your post to surface

Run a topic and the best set — strong volume without drowning — gets marked for one-click copying into your posts and Scheduler plans.

About us

Built for crypto founders, by someone who runs X accounts for a living

XRayKit is an X audit and thread generator built only for crypto and NFT founders. General tools score every creator the same way. XRayKit doesn't — it reads your profile for launch, fundraise and community signals, because that's the game you're actually playing.

It was built by Md. Mostafijur Rahman, a digital marketer and social media manager whose work is mostly in the crypto and NFT sector — managing X accounts, growing communities, and seeing first-hand how a weak bio or a hookless pinned post quietly costs a project reach right before a launch.

So XRayKit gives you the diagnosis and the fix: a 0–100 score, the problems ranked by impact, and — on Pro — the thread draft and 7-day plan that fix them.

FAQ

Before you scan

Straight answers on what XRayKit is, what the free audit covers, and how the trial works.

Is this only for crypto accounts?

Yes — deliberately. The audit weights launch, fundraise, and community signals that general tools don't even look for. If you're building in crypto or NFTs, the feedback speaks your language.

What does the free audit include?

Your 0–100 score and the problems ranked by impact, once a month. Pro adds the written fix for every problem, full thread drafts, and a 7-day plan.

What do I need to run a scan?

Your handle, your current bio, and at least 3 recent posts pasted in — one per line. A pinned post helps but isn't required; if you don't have one, the scan flags that as a finding. No X password, ever.

How does the 3-day trial work?

You get full Pro from the moment you start — no card required. When day 3 ends, the trial stops on its own; if you want to keep Pro, add a card then and it continues at $7/month.

Why 30 audits a month on Pro?

Enough to re-scan after every fix and cover a launch week comfortably — while keeping the $7 price sustainable.

Who is behind XRayKit?

Md. Mostafijur Rahman — a digital marketer and X manager who works mostly with crypto and NFT projects. More on the About Us page.

Does XRayKit post to X for me?

Not yet — and that's deliberate at launch. The Scheduler builds your drafts, times and image ideas; you paste each draft into X and set it with X's own free scheduler. That needs no X API credits and costs nothing extra. Auto-posting — the plan posting itself — arrives on a higher Growth tier, where X's per-post API cost is covered.

Can XRayKit learn from my old content?

Yes — that's the Import page. Submit links to past social posts, your website URL, a PDF (whitepaper, deck, old announcements), or paste text directly. XRayKit reads it in your browser, builds a voice profile — your topics, hook style, line length and hashtags — and from then on AI Create suggests what to post next and drafts it in your voice. Your files are read locally in this demo and stay in your session.

How does hashtag research work?

Give it a topic and it returns suggested tags with daily posts, daily comments, total volume and a High / Medium / Low competition rating — so you pick tags a small account can actually surface in, instead of drowning in the biggest ones. The demo shows sample numbers; live volume data comes with the X search connection.
